en.topic_title: Climate change, ‘super-strong’ El Niño may push Hong Kong to record-high temperatures, Observatory warns
en.topic_summary:
The Hong Kong Observatory (HKO) has warned that the city may experience record-breaking high temperatures this year and next year due to climate change and forecasts of a “super-strong” El Niño event.



A heatwave in Hong Kong in late May 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
